decisions.reason: Cleaning soap builds directly on the firm's surface-treatment and wood-care knowledge, complements its floors, and was upgraded to its own page in 2024, signalling growing commitment.
Maintenance oil draws on the firm's core oil-finish expertise and supports sales of oiled floors, so it fits existing knowledge well despite only steady website visibility.
Care products for oiled floors are closely tied to the firm's surface-treatment know-how and got a dedicated page in 2024, showing the firm has learned from early results and is expanding it.
A moisture-protection underlay is a natural accessory to its flooring systems, though it relies more on sourced materials outside core wood know-how, so the risk of dropping it is moderate but low.
High-density foam underlay is furthest from the firm's wood-processing knowledge and may overlap with product D, but as a system accessory it is still likely to be kept.
Oak parquet lies at the heart of the firm's long wood-processing expertise and manufacturing base, making it the product it is best able to assess and improve.
